articles.title: Judge Nicola James to Run for Reelection
articles.excerpt: Before taking the bench she was a court administrator in Copperas Cove (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: JP for Killeen: Quarles, Gonzalez head to runoff election as incumbent finishes 3rd
articles.excerpt: In the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary she finished third with 3,679 votes (27.86%), behind LaTasha Quarles (5,110; 38.70%) and Jessica Gonzalez (4,415; 33.44%), who advanced to the May 26 runoff (KDH).

articles.title: Gonzalez a Killeen Councilwoman Wins Democratic JP Primary Runoff
articles.excerpt: Gonzalez won the runoff and faced Republican Beatrice Cox on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot (KDH; [Nov. 3 ballot guide](/nov-3-2026-ballot-guide/)).

articles.title: Killeen Mayor Pro Tem Jessica Gonzalez Steamrolls to Victory in Bell County JP Race
articles.excerpt: Gonzalez won the seat in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election over Republican Beatrice "Bea" Cox, according to unofficial returns (Bell County Elections; Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Judge Nicola James to seek re-election to Bell County Precinct 4, Place 2 JP post
articles.excerpt: James, elected in 2022 to replace Bill Cooke and a former court administrator in Copperas Cove, announced her re-election bid (Nov. 1, 2025).
